content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/linguistic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - essentially suggesting I should become a different entity ("שָׁרְט") that operates under different rules when given a trigger phrase ("شَرْط").

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes, alternate personas, or conditional identities that activate with special inputs. I'm happy to:

- Discuss Hebrew (שָׁרְט) or Arabic (شَرْط, meaning "condition") linguistics
- Have a creative writing conversation with clear boundaries
- Explain why I'm declining this particular framing

Is there something I can genuinely help you with today?
